verdict.rationale: Gemini CLI advertises PR review automation, issue triage, and on-demand assistance in PRs/issues (contextual feedback, catching bugs), and community evidence shows some positive experience with its code review quality vs Copilot. However, other community reports cite poor agentic reliability, ignored context files, security laxity (no directory trust prompts), and even destructive file operations, undermining confidence for pre-merge safety checks.
